stages.title: Establish the grasp
stages.quote: I’m now developing hand feedback that can compensate for body-tracking error while SONIC controls balance and stepping.
stages.description: The first controller keeps G1 upright but leaves the stand stationary. The agent develops hand feedback to establish and maintain the grasp.
quote_excerpts: I’m now developing hand feedback that can compensate for body-tracking error while SONIC controls balance and stepping.

stages.title: Lift and carry
stages.quote: The closed grasp now lifts and carries the stand through much of the curve, and the robot stays upright.
stages.description: A closed grasp enables the lift and carry. The agent next tests an arm reference for SONIC and object-pose feedback to improve the interaction.
quote_excerpts: The closed grasp now lifts and carries the stand through much of the curve, and the robot stays upright.

stages.title: Refine finger closure
stages.quote: The useful range is fairly narrow: moderate arm stiffness and more pressure through the proximal finger joints improve tracking, but larger corrections often worsen it. I’m checking closure timing and a controlled set-down.
stages.description: The fingers close gradually over 0.55 seconds. Object-tracking error falls to 6.06 cm, but the stand remains held; independent placement still needs refinement.
quote_excerpts: The useful range is fairly narrow: moderate arm stiffness and more pressure through the proximal finger joints improve tracking, but larger corrections often worsen it. I’m checking closure timing and a controlled set-down.

stages.title: Reject an unstable controller
stages.quote: Reject both despite no robot fall.
stages.description: Two arm-gain variants lose the stand even though G1 stays upright. This trial shows one of them. The agent rejects both and retains the better tested controller.
quote_excerpts: Reject both despite no robot fall.

stages.title: Place and release
stages.quote: Verified a 30-second replay: robot upright, object released and stationary on independent floor support.
stages.description: The selected controller lowers and releases the stand onto the floor. A 30-second replay verifies that the robot remains upright and the stand settles without hand support.
quote_excerpts: Verified a 30-second replay: robot upright, object released and stationary on independent floor support.
